candidates.why: Fiji's pack held a Coca-Cola promo, deaf rugby and a six-month-old coaching exit; a Fijian daily with a sports desk could add current men's 15s news.
A free Fijian news site with regular rugby coverage that could fill the gap in Fiji's thin pack.
France, Japan and England packs led with July or August items or off-field filler; a dedicated rugby site would add current men's coverage.
